mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, provider_type, bucket, object_key, logical_path, logical_path_hash, name, resource_type, size, content_type, etag, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_seatunnel_web_file_resource WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'READY' ORDER BY CASE WHEN resource_type = 'DIRECTORY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, logical_path ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, owner_id, provider_type, bucket, object_key, logical_path, logical_path_hash, name, resource_type, size, content_type, etag, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_seatunnel_web_file_resource WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND logical_path = #{logicalPath} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, owner_id, provider_type, bucket, object_key, logical_path, logical_path_hash, name, resource_type, size, content_type, etag, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_seatunnel_web_file_resource WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND object_key = #{objectKey} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
